title: API Vault
description: Schema for api-vault. The UI reads this file to populate form tooltips. Field names match data-field attributes on form labels in index.html.

provider.description: Name of the service or platform (e.g. GitHub, Stripe, Jackett).

account_name.description: Username, handle, or email for the account.

api_key.description: Primary secret value — API key, bearer token, password, variable value, etc.

api_secret.description: Secondary secret that pairs with the key (client secret, shared secret, etc.).

key_id.description: Disambiguator when one provider has multiple keys (e.g. stripe_test vs stripe_live). Used in generated .env variable names.

api_description.description: Technical description of what this key does. Shown on the card by default.

description.description: Personal context — which project uses this, caveats, notes.

price_type.description: Pricing model: free = free tier; local = self-hosted; paid = active subscription; conditional = invite/membership/ratio-based.

environment.description: Target deployment environment for this key.

categories.description: Flat project tag names (UI label: Projects). Must match entries in user_categories.

api_url.description: Base API endpoint URL where requests are sent (e.g. https://api.github.com).

callback_url.description: OAuth redirect URI or webhook callback URL registered with the provider.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). UI warns when this key is close to or past expiry.

scopes.description: Permission scopes granted to this key (e.g. ["repo", "read:user"]).

custom_icon.description: Simple Icons slug to use as provider icon (e.g. "github"). Overrides auto-detection.

details.description: Extra notes or metadata not covered by other fields.

projectIds.description: Hierarchical category IDs (UI label: Categories) this entry belongs to. Always contains "Universal".

secret_type.description: Kind of secret — controls which form fields appear and how the card renders.

secretType.description: Kind of secret (internal field name — matches secret_type).

username.description: Username or login name associated with a password or SSH key entry.

email.description: Email address associated with this credential.

certificate_data.description: PEM-encoded certificate content. Used by the certificate secret type.

cert_key_data.description: PEM-encoded private key paired with this certificate entry.

blob_ref.description: File-system path or reference identifier for a file_blob credential.

env_var_subtype.description: Display hint for env_var entries: string | multiline | secret | boolean | number | ip | cidr | port | url | date | json.

version_history.description: Previous values of api_key, prepended automatically on each save when the value changes. Capped at 50 entries.

user_categories.description: Ordered list of flat project tag names (UI label: Projects). All category values in api_keys.categories must come from this list.

projects.description: Tree of hierarchical categories (UI label: Categories). Always contains the Universal catch-all entry.

id.description: Stable, lowercase, URL-safe identifier derived from name.

description.description: Optional description shown as a tooltip in the category tree.

project_type.description: High-level type — drives the special config view for WireGuard and Docker projects.

chunks.description: Structured config sections for wireguard/docker projects (WireGuard peers, Docker services, etc.).

default.name: Universal
default.description: All keys belong here by default
